## 调用链

一条用户消息的主链路（输入 → 处理 → 输出）：

**输入：**

1. UI 调 `sendUserMessage`，空消息直接忽略。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:711`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L711)
2. 同一会话还在处理中（`isLoading`）时新的发送被忽略。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:719`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L719)
3. `turnId` 自增并写入 `activeTurnId`，用于取消时识别过期回合。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:726`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L726)
4. `buildUserMessageContent` 组装用户消息内容（输入钩子、代理标签、回复标签、工作区标签、附件标签）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt:126`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt#L126)
5. 按 `shouldAddUserMessageToChat` 决定本轮是否落库用户消息。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:815`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L815)
6. 落库走 `addMessageToChat`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:872`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L872)

**处理：**

7. 取 AI 服务：`getChatInstance` 优先按会话取实例，缺失回退全局实例。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:917`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L917)
8. 发送阶段先调 `getMemoryFromMessages` 取总结之后的历史，再裁剪旧多媒体 link。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt:380`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt#L380)
9. 问插件注册表：`createExecutionIfMatched` 返回首个匹配插件的执行体，有接管就走插件。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt:431`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt#L431)
10. 无接管则调 AI 服务发送，响应流经 `shareRevisable` 共享。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt:511`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt#L511)
11. 流收集用修订追踪器处理 `SAVEPOINT`/`ROLLBACK` 事件。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:1327`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L1327)
12. 快照每 1000ms 落库一次（`claimStreamingSnapshot`）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:1283`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L1283)

**输出：**

13. `resolveFinalContent` 用重放缓存重建最终文本。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:1895`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L1895)
14. `contentStream` 置空并落库终稿。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:1908`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L1908)
15. `notifyTurnComplete` 回调回合完成，上层触发总结判断与持久化。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:1862`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L1862)
16. `cleanupRuntimeAfterSend` 复位运行时状态。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:1955`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L1955)
17. `updateCumulativeStatistics` 把服务当前计数累加到该会话的 token 统计。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/TokenStatisticsDelegate.kt:183`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/TokenStatisticsDelegate.kt#L183)

取消链路：`cancelMessage` 保留部分回复。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:564`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L564)

`cancelMessageForDestructiveMutation` 用于破坏性变更，不保留部分回复。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:575`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L575)

内部取消用 `cancellationMutex` 加锁并校验 `activeTurnId`，旧取消不会误伤新回合。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:502`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L502)

实际取消走 `cancelOperation`：插件执行、AI 服务对话、ToolPkg JS 执行三连取消。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt:644`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt#L644)

最后 `detachStreamingAiMessage` 把流消息固化落库。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt:436`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt#L436)

## 关联条目

- [聊天运行时（消息管理/Hook/插件）](/#/v1/guide/wiki/batch-04/core-chat-runtime)：本章细页，AIMessageManager 主循环、Hook 分发、插件匹配执行的完整机制。
- [对话编排运行时](/#/v1/guide/wiki/batch-04/api-chat-runtime)：EnhancedAIService 侧的发送与编排。
- [Token 统计与 usage 上报](/#/v1/guide/wiki/batch-04/api-chat-tokens)：服务侧 token 计数来源。
- [会话记忆与上下文总结](/#/v1/guide/wiki/batch-04/api-chat-memory)：总结消费侧。
- [聊天历史仓库](/#/v1/guide/wiki/batch-05/data-repo-chat)：ChatHistoryManager 的 Room 持久化细节。

## 来源

- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/AIMessageManager.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/MessageProcessingDelegate.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/CurrentChatWindowController.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/plugins/MessageProcessingPluginRegistry.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/chat/hooks/ChatRuntimeHookRegistry.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/ChatTurnOptions.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/TokenStatisticsDelegate.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/services/core/ChatHistoryDelegate.kt`

pages.title: 工具注册与执行框架
pages.text:
# 工具注册与执行框架

## 概述

- 调度核心是 `AIToolHandler`（单例），集中管理工具的注册、钩子与执行。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:29`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L29)
- 注册表是它内部的 `availableTools`（`ConcurrentHashMap`），按工具名映射执行器。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:45`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L45)

## 注册机制

- `registerTool` 是唯一的注册方法，同名重复注册会直接覆盖旧执行器。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:184`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L184)
- `registerTool` 另有重载，接受 `(AITool) -> ToolResult` 类型的 lambda，简化无流式需求的工具注册。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:193`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L193)
- 上述 lambda 重载内部被包成匿名 `object : ToolExecutor`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:202`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L202)
- `registerDefaultTools()` 用双重检查保证全部内置工具只注册一次。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:211`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L211)
- 幂等标志 `defaultToolsRegistered` 是 `AtomicBoolean` 类型。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:48`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L48)
- `unregisterTool(toolName)` 按名移除注册。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:59`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L59)
- `reset()` 在同一 `synchronized` 块内清空注册表、置空 `packageManagerInstance`、重置注册标志。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:277`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L277)
- `getAllToolNames()` 返回当前已注册的全部工具名。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:160`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L160)

## 集中注册（ToolRegistration）

- `registerAllTools` 是集中注册全部内置工具的顶层函数。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:36`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L36)
- 文件内共调用 `handler.registerTool` 182 次，工具名无重复。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:270`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L270)
- `execute_shell` 在注释中标注为"不在提示词加入的工具"。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:270`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L270)
- `close_all_virtual_displays` 同样标注为不在提示词加入。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:282`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L282)
- 注册按功能分组组织：shell/终端、音乐播放、软件设置、记忆组、蓝牙组等。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:270`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L270)
- `use_package` 通过包管理器激活沙盒包。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1002`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1002)
- 浏览器工具组共 22 个，以 `browser_click` 起始。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1230`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1230)
- 浏览器工具组以 `browser_wait_for` 结束。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1373`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1373)
- 蓝牙工具组覆盖经典蓝牙与 BLE，以 `get_bluetooth_state` 起始。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:2432`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L2432)
- 计算器工具用 `getCalculator().evalExpression(expression)` 求表达式的值。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1187`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1187)

## 执行框架（调用链）

- `executeTool(tool: AITool): ToolResult` 是同步执行入口。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:363`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L363)
- 调用链共 8 步：
  1. `notifyToolCallRequested(tool)` 通知钩子"收到调用请求"。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:95`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L95)
  2. `checkToolInterception(tool)` 逐个询问钩子是否放行。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:100`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L100)
  3. 拦截决策类型是 `AIToolHookDecision.Block`（携带原因字符串）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:7`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L7)
  4. 钩子回调本身抛异常时直接按阻断处理（fail-closed）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:107`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L107)
  5. 被拦截时用 `buildToolInterceptionResult` 构造失败结果并返回。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:120`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L120)
  - 构造的结果 `success=false`、`error` 为拦截原因。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:126`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L126)
  6. `getToolExecutorOrActivate(tool.name)` 获取执行器：缺失时先补一次默认注册。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:303`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L303)
  7. 工具名含冒号时自动调用 `usePackage` 激活对应工具包。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:324`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L324)
  8. MCP 包可用但服务不活跃时自动重新激活。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:345`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L345)
- 执行器仍缺失则返回 `Tool not found` 的失败结果。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:383`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L383)
- `executor.validateParameters(tool)` 做参数校验。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:391`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L391)
- 参数校验不通过时返回携带 `errorMessage` 的失败结果。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:398`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L398)
- `notifyToolExecutionStarted` 后调用 `executor.invoke(tool)`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:405`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L405)
- 成功时 `notifyToolExecutionResult`；抛异常时 `notifyToolExecutionError` 并重新抛出。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:408`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L408)
- `finally` 中必调 `notifyToolExecutionFinished`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:414`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L414)
- `executeToolAndStream(tool): Flow<ToolResult>` 是流式执行入口：拦截、缺失、校验逻辑与同步入口一致。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:419`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L419)
- 流式入口把执行器的中间结果逐个 `emit` 并通知钩子。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:467`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L467)
- `ToolExecutor` 接口只强制实现 `invoke`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:479`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L479)
- `invokeAndStream` 默认实现为 `flowOf(invoke(tool))`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:482`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L482)
- `validateParameters` 默认返回有效。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:488`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L488)
- 4 个内置工具用匿名 `object : ToolExecutor` 同时覆写 `invoke` 与 `invokeAndStream`，支持真正的流式输出。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:341`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L341)
  - `execute_in_terminal_session_streaming`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:331`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L331)
  - `send_message_to_ai_streaming`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1707`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1707)
  - `http_request`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1967`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1967)
  - `apply_file`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:2123`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L2123)
- `replaceToolInvocation` 按调用位置切开响应原文，把调用点替换为结果块。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:233`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L233)
- 结果块以 `**Tool Result [工具名]:**` 为标题头。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:249`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L249)

## Hook 机制

- `AIToolHookDecision` 是密封类，只有 `Allow` 与携带 `reason` 字符串的 `Block` 两种决策。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:7`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L7)
- `AIToolHook` 接口定义 7 个生命周期回调，全部有默认空实现。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:16`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L16)
- `onToolCallRequested`：收到调用请求。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:18`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L18)
- `onToolCallIntercept` 是唯一能阻断调用的决策点，默认返回 `Allow`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:21`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L21)
- `onToolPermissionChecked`：权限检查完成后。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:24`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L24)
- `onToolExecutionStarted`：实际执行开始前。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:27`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L27)
- `onToolExecutionResult`：产出执行结果时。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:30`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L30)
- `onToolExecutionError`：执行抛异常时。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:33`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L33)
- `onToolExecutionFinished`：请求生命周期结束时。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt:36`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt#L36)
- 钩子存放在 `CopyOnWriteArrayList` 中。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:46`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L46)
- `addToolHook` 添加时判重。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:67`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L67)
- 钩子回调按文档要求必须是轻量的。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:67`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L67)
- `notifyHooks` 对每个钩子回调用 `try/catch` 包裹，单个钩子异常只记日志。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt:84`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt#L84)

## 执行限额（ToolExecutionLimits）

- `MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES = 32_000`：文件读取的字节上限。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt:4`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt#L4)
- `DEFAULT_FILE_READ_PART_LINES = 200`：文件分段读取的默认行数。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt:5`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt#L5)
- `MAX_TEXT_RESULT_LENGTH = 5_000`：文本结果的长度上限。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt:6`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt#L6)
- `MAX_SINGLE_TOOL_RESULT_MESSAGE_CHARS` 等于 `MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES` 的两倍：单个工具结果发回模型的字符上限。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt:8`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt#L8)

## 进度总线（ToolProgressBus）

- `ToolProgressEvent` 包含 `toolName`、`progress`、`message`、`priority`、`level`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt:7`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt#L7)
- `ToolProgressBus` 是 object 单例，对外暴露 `StateFlow<ToolProgressEvent?>` 类型的进度流。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt:15`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt#L15)
- `SUMMARY_PROGRESS_TOOL_NAME` 为 `"__SUMMARY__"`，优先级 1000 全场最高。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt:16`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt#L16)
- 工具进度优先级：`grep_context`（100）、`grep_code`（10）、`find_files`（5），其余为 0。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt:21`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt#L21)
- 进度更新只在四种情况下替换当前事件：无当前事件、同一工具、当前进度已完成、新优先级更高。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt:46`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt#L46)
- 同优先级时 `level` 更高才替换。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt:50`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt#L50)
- `clear()` 把进度流置为 null。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt:57`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt#L57)

## 工具包模型（ToolPackage）

- `ToolPackage` 是工具包的清单数据类。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:301`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L301)
- 清单字段：`name`、`description`（多语言）、`tools`、`states`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:302`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L302)
- 清单字段：`env`（环境变量声明）、`isBuiltIn`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:327`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L327)
- `enabledByDefault`（JSON 名 `enabled_by_default`）控制是否默认启用。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:330`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L330)
- `displayName`、`category`（默认 `"Other"`）用于展示分类。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:332`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L332)
- `author`（兼容字符串或数组）、`version`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:335`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L335)
- `LocalizedText` 是多语言文本（`Map<String, String>`）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:39`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L39)
- `LocalizedText.resolve(context)` 按系统 locale 逐级回退取文本。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:43`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L43)
- 回退顺序为语言标签、`language`、`default`、`en`、`zh`，最后取首个值。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:73`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L73)
- `LocalizedTextSerializer` 处理多语言文本的序列化。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:128`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L128)
- 值仅含 `default` 时写成纯字符串，否则写成 map。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:158`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L158)
- `StringOrStringListSerializer` 反序列化兼容字符串或字符串数组。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:170`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L170)
- 单个元素序列化时写成纯字符串。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:193`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L193)
- `EnvVar` 声明包的环境变量：`name`、`description`、`required`（默认 true）、`defaultValue`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:204`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L204)
- `EnvVarSerializer` 兼容新旧两种环境变量格式。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:215`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L215)
- 旧格式的裸字符串视为必填。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:227`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L227)
- `ToolPackageState` 定义条件工具集：`id`、`condition`（默认 `"true"`）、`inheritTools`、`excludeTools`、`tools`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:340`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L340)
- `PackageTool` 是包内的单个工具：`name`、`description`、`parameters`、`script`（定义工具行为的 JavaScript 脚本）、`advice`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:352`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L352)
- `PackageToolParameter` 有 `name`、`description`、`type`、`required`（默认 true）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:364`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L364)
- `PackageToolExecutor.invoke` 要求工具名恰为 `packageName:toolName` 两段式。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:382`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L382)
- 包名不匹配或包内无此工具都返回失败的 `ToolResult`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:390`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L390)
- 执行时用 `runBlocking` 跑脚本并取流的最后一个结果。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:418`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L418)
- `invokeAndStream` 按名称后缀在包内查找工具，直接返回脚本执行的 `Flow`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:423`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L423)
- `validateParameters` 校验必填参数是否齐全。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:431`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L431)
- 缺失时 `errorMessage` 列出缺失的参数名。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:468`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L468)
- `describePackage()` 生成带本地化描述与参数类型表的人类可读包说明。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt:478`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt#L478)

## 结果类型体系（ToolResultDataClasses）

- `ToolResultData` 是 `@Serializable` 的密封基类。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:17`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L17)
- `toJson` 用 `classDiscriminator = "__type"` 做多态序列化。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:23`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L23)
- 设计上刻意区分两个通道：`toString()` 输出给 AI 模型读的文本，结构化字段用于序列化与持久化。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:17`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L17)
- `BinaryResultData` 持有 `ByteArray`，`toString` 只报告字节数。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:211`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L211)
- `BinaryResultData` 手动重写 `equals` 做内容比较。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:214`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L214)
- `BinaryResultData` 配套重写了 `hashCode`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:221`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L221)
- 防爆截断遍布各结果类：
  - `VisitWebResultData` 是网页访问的结果类型。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:1048`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L1048)
  - 其伴生对象定义 `MAX_INLINE_LINKS` 与 `MAX_INLINE_IMAGES`（均为 120）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:1061`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L1061)
  - 超限时截断并提示用 `read_file_part` 或 `grep_code` 查看落盘文件。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:1103`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L1103)
  - `FindFilesResultData` 超过 20 个文件时只列前 10。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:1143`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L1143)
  - grep 结果最多展示 30 个匹配组。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:1712`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L1712)
  - `MessageSendResultData` 把消息截断为 50 字符预览、AI 回复截断为 200 字符预览。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:2227`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L2227)
  - `HttpResponseData` 最多展示 5 个 cookie，值截断 30 字符。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:600`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L600)
  - 聊天记录结果的 `toString` 只输出摘要（chatId、order、limit 与总数），不输出消息正文。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:2154`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L2154)
- 语音与模型配置结果只保存 `apiKeySet` 布尔值与 `apiKeyPreview` 预览。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:2324`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L2324)
- `TerminalStreamEventData` 的 `toString` 在 `type` 为 chunk 时直接返回分片内容。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:293`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L293)
- 文件类结果普遍带 `env` 字段（`@EncodeDefault`，默认 `"android"`），标记结果来源环境。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:237`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L237)
- `AppOperationData.toString()` 按 `operationType` 组装文本，未使用 `success` 字段。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:674`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L674)
- `ConnectionResultData.toString()` 只输出 `connectionId`，未使用 `isActive`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt:404`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt#L404)

## 代理调用

- `parseProxyInvocation` 要求代理调用恰好一个 `tool_name` 与一个 `params` 参数。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:107`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L107)
- `params` 的 JSON 对象被转成 `ToolParameter` 列表透传给被代理工具。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:163`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L163)
- `__operit_package_caller_name`、`__operit_package_chat_id`、`__operit_package_caller_card_id` 三个包上下文参数允许透传。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:81`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L81)
- CLI 代理工具执行前走 `executeProxyTargetWithPermissionCheck`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:221`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L221)
- 该路径调用 `checkToolPermission` 做工具权限检查。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:241`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L241)
- 权限拒绝时通知结果 `granted=false`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:247`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L247)
- `package_proxy` 要求目标为带包名的限定格式。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1140`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1140)
- `package_proxy` 禁止目标为 `package_proxy` 自身。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1157`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1157)
- 代理调用随后直接走 `handler.executeTool` 执行。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:1165`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L1165)
- `update_user_preferences` 是兼容别名，故意不在系统提示词中出现。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:852`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L852)
- `update_user_profile` 是新会话使用的正式工具名。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt:836`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt#L836)

## 关联条目

- [[core-tools|工具系统总览]]：v2 条目，本页是其细粒度展开。
- [[api-chat|对话与 API]]：工具调用请求的来源。
- [[data-model|数据模型]]：`AITool`、`ToolResult` 的定义。

## 来源

- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHandler.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/AIToolHook.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolExecutionLimits.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolProgressBus.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolPackage.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolRegistration.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/core/tools/ToolResultDataClasses.kt`

pages.title: 工具系统（总览）
pages.text:
# 工具系统（总览）

## 概述

- 工具是 Operit 里"AI 能动手干的事"：读文件、上网搜索、发消息、调系统能力，全部以工具的形式交给模型调用。你让 AI"查一下今天的天气"，它在回复里夹带一次工具调用，App 替它执行、把结果喂回去，它再组织成自然语言回答你。
- 本页只回答两个问题：① 工具在代码里长什么样（数据模型）；② 一次工具调用在对话增强管线里怎么被调度（执行编排）。
- 工具的注册表、Hook、执行限额、进度总线、工具包模型、结果类型体系由细页 [工具注册与执行框架](/#/v1/guide/wiki/batch-02/core-tools-registry) 深度覆盖，本页不重复搬运。

## AI 速览

- `AITool` — 工具的定义：`name` + `parameters` + `description`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:12`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L12)
- `ToolParameter` — 单个参数：`name` + `value` 两个字符串。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:8`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L8)
- `ToolInvocation` — 模型响应中的一次调用：`tool` + `rawText` + `responseLocation`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:21`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L21)
- `ToolResult` — 执行结果：`toolName` + `success` + `result`（`ToolResultData`）+ `error`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:29`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L29)
- `ToolValidationResult` — 参数校验结果：`valid` + `errorMessage`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:37`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L37)
- `ToolExecutionManager` — `object` 单例，工具执行的总调度。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:38`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L38)
- `extractToolInvocations` — 主入口之一：从模型响应文本解析出工具调用列表。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:306`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L306)
- `executeInvocations` — 主入口之二：批量执行入口，三关拦截 → 并行/串行执行 → 有序聚合。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:504`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L504)
- `executeToolSafely` — 单调用安全包装：参数校验 → 流式执行 → 异常转失败结果。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:388`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L388)
- `aggregateToolResults` — 把 `Flow<ToolResult>` 聚合成单个 `ToolResult`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:710`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L710)
- `checkToolPermission` — 权限检查，返回是否放行与错误结果的二元组。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:429`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L429)
- `resolveToolTarget` — 代理调用（package_proxy / CLI 代理）还原出真实目标工具。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:67`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L67)
- `buildToolNotAvailableErrorMessage` — 按工具名形态构造"工具不可用"的提示文案。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:743`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L743)
- 数据流向一句话：模型响应文本 → XML 解析出 `ToolInvocation` → 三关门禁（暴露模式 / 角色卡 / Hook+权限）→ 并行或串行执行 → 流式结果聚合为 `ToolResult` → 结果标记注入回消息流。

## 核心机制

### 工具的数据长相

- 工具的定义极简：`AITool` 只有三个字段——`name`（调哪个工具）、`parameters`（参数列表，默认空）、`description`（给模型看的描述，默认空）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:14`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L14)
- 参数是键值对：`ToolParameter` 的 `name` 和 `value` 都是字符串，复杂结构由调用方自己序列化成字符串塞进去。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:8`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L8)
- 模型"想调工具"时，真正流转的是 `ToolInvocation`：被调的 `AITool`、原始文本 `rawText`、以及调用在响应中的位置区间 `responseLocation`（`IntRange`，`@Contextual` 标注）。位置信息用来把结果插回原文对应处。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:24`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L24)
- 执行完产出 `ToolResult`：`toolName`、`success`、结构化载荷 `result`（类型 `ToolResultData`，由 `core.tools` 包提供）、失败原因 `error`（可空，默认 `null`）。成功与失败走同一个结构，调用方只看 `success` 分流。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:33`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L33)
- 参数校验的结果单独建模为 `ToolValidationResult`（`valid` + `errorMessage`），校验不过时错误信息原样拼进失败结果。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:37`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L37)
- 设计上数据与调度分离：`AITool` 家族是纯数据类（可序列化、跨层传递），`ToolExecutionManager` 只做编排、不持有任何工具实现——真正的执行器来自 `AIToolHandler` 的注册表（注册细节见 [工具注册与执行框架](/#/v1/guide/wiki/batch-02/core-tools-registry)）。

### 调度的五道工序（`executeInvocations`）

- 第 0 步先保底：真正执行前调 `toolHandler.registerDefaultTools()`，注释写明默认注册幂等且线程安全、可安全重复调用——启动阶段若推迟了注册，这里补上。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:521`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L521)
- 第 1 关是顶层工具暴露模式拦截：`buildToolExposureDeniedResult` 按 `toolExposureMode` 裁决。CLI 模式下调了非公开工具、或完整模式下调了 CLI 专属工具，直接判拒绝。两种模式各有一套工具集，互不串用。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:544`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L544)
- 第 2 关是角色卡准入：`callerCardId` 非空时先用 `CharacterCardToolAccessResolver` 解析出该角色卡的工具权限，再逐个判定。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:528`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L528)
- 角色卡判定按工具名形态分六路：CLI 搜索工具恒放行；CLI 代理看解析后的真实目标；use_package 先查内置准入、再查 package_name 指向的外部源；package_proxy 先查内置准入、再查解析目标；"包名:工具名"形态查包的外部源准入；普通工具名查内置准入。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:149`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L149)
- 第 3 关是 Hook 拦截与权限检查：先 `notifyToolCallRequested`，再用 `resolveToolTarget` 还原真实目标并做 `checkToolInterception`；决策为 `Allow` 时继续走 `checkToolPermission`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:575`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L575)
- Hook 决策为 `Block` 时用 `buildToolInterceptionResult` 构造拦截结果，并通知执行结束。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:588`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L588)
- 权限检查 `checkToolPermission` 里有个显眼的后门：`rawText` 含 `deny_tool` 标记时跳过权限弹窗、直接放行（通知理由记为 `"Permission check bypassed by deny_tool tag."`）。CLI 模式的搜索/代理工具同样自动放行（`"CLI public tool"`）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:458`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L458)
- 放行后、执行前还有一步包上下文注入：调用方信息（名字/聊天 id/角色卡 id）非空时，给 JS 包工具（`包名:工具名` 且包名在可用包集合中）的调用追加三个 `__operit_package_*` 参数，让包内脚本知道"是谁在调我"。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:601`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L601)
- 第 4 步按并行/串行分组：`parallelizableToolNames` 是 12 个工具名的白名单（`list_files`、`read_file`、`read_file_part`、`read_file_full`、`file_exists`、`find_files`、`file_info`、`grep_code`、`calculate`、`ffmpeg_info`、`visit_web`、`download_file`），全部是只读/查询型工具。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:621`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L621)
- 白名单内的调用 `async` 并行跑，白名单外的串行跑。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:634`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L634)
- 第 5 步执行并有序聚合：并行任务启动后 `awaitAll` 等齐；每个结果按原始调用下标登记，全部到齐后 `finish()` 返回批量结果。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:660`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L660)
- `OrderedToolResults` 按调用下标聚合结果，结果标记经 `ensureOwnLine` 处理后由 `collector.emit` 发布。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:515`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L515)
- 结果标记通过 `collector.emit(ensureOwnLine(markup))` 写回消息流；`ensureOwnLine` 保证标记块独占一行——注释解释了原因：XML 块检测器只在行边界处开块，粘在上一行末尾的标记会被当成普通模型文本渲染，下一轮从历史里就解析不出来了。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:62`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L62)

### 单次执行的包装（`executeToolSafely`）

- 每个工具调用先过 `executor.validateParameters` 参数校验；不过则直接返回失败结果，错误形如 `"Invalid parameters: ..."`，不走到执行器。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:393`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L393)
- 执行走 `executor.invokeAndStream` 的流式接口，异常被 `catch` 接住：记日志、通知 `toolHandler.notifyToolExecutionError`，再转成 `"Tool execution error: ..."` 的失败 `ToolResult` 发出去——调用方永远拿到结构化的失败结果，而不是崩溃。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:407`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L407)
- 流式多段结果由 `aggregateToolResults` 收拢：收集 `Flow` 内的全部 `ToolResult`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:710`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L710)
- 流式结果为空时返回携带无结果 `error` 的失败 `ToolResult`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:721`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L721)
- 成功段拼文本、失败段加 `Step error` 前缀，最终 `success` 取最后一段，整体包成 `StringResultData`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:729`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L729)

### 代理调用的还原（`resolveToolTarget`）

- 调度层用 `resolveToolTarget` 还原代理调用：非代理调用原样返回，package_proxy 与 CLI 代理则从参数中抠出真实目标。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:67`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L67)
- 真实目标名取自 `tool_name` 参数。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:74`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L74)
- `params` 参数的 JSON 对象展开为目标的参数列表。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:277`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L277)
- 关键点：Hook 拦截、权限检查、错误展示用的都是解析后的真实目标名，而不是代理名——权限不会按代理名误判。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:576`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L576)
- `params` JSON 解析失败（`runCatching`）时静默返回空参数列表。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:284`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L284)
- JSON 的 `null` 值转成字符串 `"null"`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:292`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L292)

## 关键符号

- `AITool`（`name`/`parameters`/`description`）：工具定义的最小数据结构。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:12`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L12)
- `ToolInvocation`（`tool`/`rawText`/`responseLocation`）：一次调用的完整快照，位置用于结果回填。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:20`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L20)
- `ToolResult`（`toolName`/`success`/`result`/`error`）：成功失败同构的结果结构。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt:29`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/data/model/AITool.kt#L29)
- `ToolExecutionManager.extractToolInvocations`：响应文本 → `List<ToolInvocation>` 的解析入口（suspend）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:306`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L306)
- `ToolExecutionManager.executeInvocations`：批量调度总入口（suspend）。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:504`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L504)
- 批量执行在 `coroutineScope` 内运行，返回 `ToolExecutionBatch`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:514`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L514)
- `ToolExecutionManager.checkToolPermission`：权限检查，返回 `(hasPermission, errorResult)`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:429`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L429)
- `ToolExecutionManager.executeToolSafely`：校验 + 流式执行 + 异常转失败结果的单调用包装。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:388`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L388)
- `ToolExecutionManager.aggregateToolResults`：`Flow<ToolResult>` 聚合成单个 `ToolResult`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:710`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L710)
- `ToolExecutionManager.buildToolNotAvailableErrorMessage`：按工具名形态（点号/冒号/纯名）构造不可用提示。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:743`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L743)
- `ToolRuntimeContext`（`callerCardId`/`toolExposureMode`）：经 `ThreadLocal` 带入执行协程的运行时上下文。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:46`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L46)
- `ToolExposureMode`（`FULL`/`CLI`）：两套互斥的工具暴露模式，定义在 `CliToolModeSupport.kt`。

## 调用链

**输入 → 解析出调用**

1. 模型响应文本进入 `extractToolInvocations`，转成字符流并用 `StreamXmlPlugin` 做 XML 块切分。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:310`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L310)
2. 每个 XML 块用 `ChatMarkupRegex.toolCallPattern` 匹配工具调用，工具名取匹配组 `[2]`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:321`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L321)
3. 参数用 `MessageContentParser.toolParamPattern` 从块体提取，值经 `unescapeXml` 还原转义，封装为 `AITool`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:330`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L330)
4. 调用位置 `toolMatch.range` 存入 `responseLocation`，供结果回填定位。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:338`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L338)

**处理 → 三关门禁与执行**

4. 批量执行先保底调 `registerDefaultTools()`，再依次过三关：暴露模式拦截 → 角色卡准入 → Hook 拦截 + 权限检查；任一关拒绝即登记失败结果，不再往下走。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:521`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L521)
5. 放行调用按需注入包调用上下文（三个 `__operit_package_*` 参数），再按 12 个只读工具白名单分成并行组与串行组。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:601`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L601)
6. 私有 executeTool 执行单个调用：用 `getToolExecutorOrActivate(toolName)` 取执行器。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:679`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L679)
7. 执行器缺失时用 `buildToolNotAvailableErrorMessage` 构造不可用错误。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:683`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L683)
8. 执行前发 `notifyToolExecutionStarted` 通知，再经 `executeToolSafely` 走流式执行。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:695`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L695)
9. `finally` 块必调 `notifyToolExecutionFinished`。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:703`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L703)
10. 执行期用 `toolRuntimeContextThreadLocal.asContextElement` 把运行时上下文带入协程。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:677`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L677)

**输出 → 聚合回填**

7. 流式结果逐段收拢：成功段拼文本、失败段加 `Step error` 前缀，最终 `success` 取最后一段。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:726`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L726)
8. 结果按原始调用下标排回原顺序，`finish()` 得到批量结果。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:662`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L662)
9. 结果标记经 `ensureOwnLine` 独占一行后 `emit` 进消息流，供下一轮模型请求复用。[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt:516`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/api/chat/enhance/ToolExecutionManager.kt#L516)
