**链路 1：打开工具箱点进小工具**
1. 输入：用户打开工具箱页。
2. 处理：取 `navigationEntries` 按 `surface == NavigationSurface.TOOLBOX` 过滤（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt:67`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt#L67)）。
   再 `map` 为 `Tool`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt:72`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt#L72)）。
   经 `LazyVerticalGrid` 展示（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt:87`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt#L87)）。
3. 输出：点击卡片 `delay(100)` 后调 `onClick`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt:125`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt#L125)）。
   路由挂载对应的 `*ToolScreen` 包装函数（`FFmpegToolboxToolScreen`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt:256`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/ToolboxScreen.kt#L256)）。

**链路 2：改某个应用的权限**
1. 输入：点应用条目（`AppItem` 的 `onClick`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt:399`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt#L399)）。
2. 处理：拿 dumpsys 全量输出（`packageInfoResult`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt:1144`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt#L1144)）。
   grep 提已授予（`grantedPermsResult`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt:1149`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt#L1149)）。
   分段解析（`extractSectionContent`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt:1158`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt#L1158)）。
   分组为 `PermissionInfo`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt:1345`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt#L1345)）。
3. 输出：拨开关拼 pm 命令执行（`rawName`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt:169`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/apppermissions/AppPermissionsScreen.kt#L169)）。

**链路 3：AutoGLM 执行自动化任务**
1. 输入：任务屏输入任务点执行（`isLoading` 为假调 `onExecute`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmToolScreen.kt:84`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmToolScreen.kt#L84)）。
2. 处理：`executeTask` 取消旧 `executionJob`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt:45`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt#L45)）。
   虚拟屏模式建 Shower 显示（`ensureDisplay`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt:82`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt#L82)）。
   自动化 Agent 25 步循环（`AgentConfig`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt:109`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt#L109)），工具取自 `getUITools`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt:111`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt#L111)）。
3. 输出：日志区自动滚动（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmToolScreen.kt:108`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmToolScreen.kt#L108)）。
   点 Cancel 调 `cancelTask`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt:193`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/autoglm/AutoGlmViewModel.kt#L193)）。

**链路 4：HTML 打包成应用**
1. 输入：`OpenDocumentTree` 选文件夹（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt:64`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt#L64)）。
   选主文件（`selectedIndexFile`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt:70`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt#L70)）。
2. 处理：`copyDocumentTreeTo` 复制到临时目录（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt:193`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt#L193)）。
   `renameTo` 改名 index.html（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt:199`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt#L199)）。
   `exportAndroidApp` 导出（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt:207`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt#L207)）。
3. 输出：完成对话框 `onOpenFile` 打开产物（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt:318`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt#L318)）。
   `finally` 清临时目录（`deleteRecursively`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt:231`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/htmlpackager/HtmlPackagerScreen.kt#L231)）。

**链路 5：语音识别**
1. 输入：点"开始识别"（`startRecognition`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/speechtotext/SpeechToTextScreen.kt:186`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/speechtotext/SpeechToTextScreen.kt#L186)）。
2. 处理：`recognitionMode` 变化重建服务（`createSpeechService`）（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/speechtotext/SpeechToTextScreen.kt:130`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/speechtotext/SpeechToTextScreen.kt#L130)）。
   离屏 `onDispose` 关服务（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/speechtotext/SpeechToTextScreen.kt:138`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/speechtotext/SpeechToTextScreen.kt#L138)）。
3. 输出：识别文本可 `copyToClipboard`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/speechtotext/SpeechToTextScreen.kt:228`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/speechtotext/SpeechToTextScreen.kt#L228)）。

## 来源

- 种子：`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/` 下 15 个 Kotlin 文件（`apppermissions/` 1 个、`autoglm/` 4 个、`defaultassistant/` 1 个、`ffmpegtoolbox/` 1 个、`htmlpackager/` 1 个、`processlimit/` 1 个、`speechtotext/` 2 个、`texttospeech/` 2 个 + `ToolboxScreen.kt`、`ProcessLimitRemoverToolScreen.kt`），约 6,046 行，源码 commit `dbf71916`。
- 原子事实见 `ui-toolbox-apps.facts.json`（160 条），代码走查见 `ui-toolbox-apps.quality.json`（12 条：0 高 / 5 警告 / 7 建议），lint 报告见 `ui-toolbox-apps.lint.md`。

pages.title: 开发调试工具界面（ui-toolbox-dev）
pages.text:
# 开发调试工具界面（ui-toolbox-dev）

> 种子范围：`ui/features/toolbox/screens/` 下 shellexecutor（2）/ sqlviewer（4）/ logcat（6）/ uidebugger（5）/ tooltester（1）/ StreamMarkdownDemo.kt（1），共 20 个文件约 5035 行 @ `dbf71916`。
> 走查：代码走查发现 12 条（高 1 / 警告 3 / 建议 8），见 `ui-toolbox-dev.quality.json`。

## 概述

这是 Operit App 里「工具箱」标签页的开发调试工具集合：6 组界面，各自独立。

| 工具 | 入口文件 | 一句话 |
|---|---|---|
| Shell 执行器 | `ShellExecutorScreen.kt` | 输入命令、点运行，在设备上执行 shell |
| SQL 查看器 | `SqlViewerScreen.kt` | 手写 SQL，查 App 的正式数据库 |
| 日志导出 | `LogcatScreen.kt` | 一键把 App 日志存成 txt |
| UI 调试器 | `UIDebuggerScreen.kt` | 悬浮窗圈选界面元素、点击、监听 Activity |
| 工具测试 | `ToolTesterScreen.kt` | 批量跑一遍 AI 工具，看成功还是失败 |
| 流式渲染演示 | `StreamMarkdownDemo.kt` | 演示 Markdown 逐字流式渲染 |

它们有个共同点：都是「开发者给自己造的瑞士军刀」，界面朴素、功能直接。其中 SQL 查看器直接操作正式库、UI 调试器常驻悬浮窗，这两个是全 App 里权限最「重」的调试界面。

## AI 速览

- **核心符号**：`ShellCommandManager`（命令管理）、`SqlTableView`（原生缩放表格）、`SqlViewerViewModel`（SQL 执行）、`UIDebuggerViewModel`（单例，悬浮窗共用）、`UIDebuggerOverlay`（悬浮窗）、`LogcatExportHelper`（日志落盘）、`runTest`（工具测试执行）、`StreamMarkdownDemoScreen`（流式演示）
- **主入口**：6 个 Screen 各自是独立入口，均挂在工具箱导航下；`SqlViewerToolScreen` 只是给 `SqlViewerScreen` 套了个 `CustomScaffold` 的壳（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerToolScreen.kt:11`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerToolScreen.kt#L11)）
- **数据流向一句话**：用户输入（命令/SQL/点击）→ 各自的 Manager/ViewModel 在 IO 线程干活 → 结果回填到 Compose 界面展示

## 核心机制

### 1. Shell 执行器：命令输入框 + 16 条预设 + 结果卡

`ShellExecutorScreen` 是最简单的结构：顶部命令输入框、中间预设区、底部结果列表（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt:83`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt#L83)）。

- **16 条预设命令**分 5 类（系统/文件/网络/硬件/包管理），名称和命令文本都取自 string 资源（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellCommandManager.kt:30`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellCommandManager.kt#L30)）
- 输入框边输边给建议：`LaunchedEffect(commandInput)` 实时刷新（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt:107`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt#L107)），但建议源 `getSuggestedCommands` 读的是永远为空的历史（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellCommandManager.kt:230`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellCommandManager.kt#L230)）——历史持久化根本没实现（见走查第 4 条）
- 空命令直接返回不执行（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt:122`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt#L122)）；执行按钮的启用条件就是输入框非空（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt:266`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt#L266)）
- 结果卡用绿/红圆点表示成功失败（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt:610`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt#L610)），分三段展示 stdout、stderr、exitCode，非零 exitCode 标红（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt:697`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt#L697)）
- 每条结果卡带「重新执行」按钮，直接重跑同一条命令（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt:707`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellExecutorScreen.kt#L707)）

### 2. SQL 查看器：手写 SQL 查正式库 + 原生手绘表格

这是权限最重的一个：执行的数据库是 `AppDatabase.getDatabase(context).openHelper.writableDatabase`——App 自己的正式库（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerViewModel.kt:39`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerViewModel.kt#L39)）。

- 默认候选表 `chats`/`messages`，输入框预填 `SELECT * FROM chats`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerScreen.kt:51`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerScreen.kt#L51)）
- 两个快捷芯片：一键填「查所有表名」的 `sqlite_master` 语句，一键填 `PRAGMA table_info(chats)` 查表结构（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerScreen.kt:166`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerScreen.kt#L166)）

### 4. UI 调试器：悬浮窗圈选元素 + Activity 监听

这是最复杂的一组，4 个文件配合一个悬浮窗服务。

- **启动**：右下角 FAB；有悬浮窗权限就启动 `UIDebuggerService`，没有就跳到系统 overlay 权限设置页（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerScreen.kt:45`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerScreen.kt#L45)）
- **单例 ViewModel**：`UIDebuggerViewModel.getInstance()` 双重检查锁，主界面、悬浮窗、服务三处共用同一份状态（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt:48`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt#L48)）
- **抓取界面**：点「分析」→ 先隐藏悬浮窗、等 300ms → 调 get_page_info 工具拿整棵 UI 树（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt:148`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt#L148)）
- 树转元素列表经 `convertToUIElements` 递归（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt:194`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt#L194)）
- 每个元素用 `UUID` 生成 id，边界从 `[l,t][r,b]` 字符串解析并减去状态栏高度（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt:237`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt#L237)）
- **圈选**：悬浮窗上的 `ElementHighlightOverlay` 全屏透明层（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerComponents.kt:427`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerComponents.kt#L427)），点一下就找出包含点击点的最小面积元素
- 选中元素画红色 2dp 矩形框（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerComponents.kt:469`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerComponents.kt#L469)），并弹出信息面板展示类名/文本/资源 id/包名，可复制（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerComponents.kt:483`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerComponents.kt#L483)）

## 调用链

1. **Shell 执行**：输入框输入命令 → `executeCommand`（IO 线程）→ AndroidShellExecutor 执行 → 结果回填 → 结果卡展示 stdout/stderr/exitCode（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellCommandManager.kt:171`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/shellexecutor/ShellCommandManager.kt#L171)）
2. **SQL 查询**：输入 SQL 点运行 → `runQuery` 判语句类型 → 查询走游标转行，写入走 execSQL + changes() 计数 → 表格重绘（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerViewModel.kt:41`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/sqlviewer/SqlViewerViewModel.kt#L41)）
3. **日志导出**：点保存 → `saveLogsToFile`（`_isSaving` 防重入）→ 导出助手读日志文件 → Q+ 走 MediaStore，以下走文件系统 → 提示 3 秒消失（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/logcat/LogcatViewModel.kt:33`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/logcat/LogcatViewModel.kt#L33)）
4. **UI 元素抓取**：悬浮窗点「分析」→ `refreshUI` 隐藏悬浮窗 → 300ms 后调 get_page_info 工具拿整棵 UI 树 → 递归转成元素列表（每个元素分配 UUID 做 id）→ 高亮层可点选（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt:148`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt#L148)）
5. **元素点击**：点选元素后构造 click_element 工具调用，用 `ByResourceId`/`ByText` 选择器定位，经工具处理器执行（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt:97`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt#L97)）
6. **Activity 监听**：点开始监听 → `getHighestAvailableListener` 取监听器 → 事件回调过滤本包名 → 保留最近 100 条 → 面板倒序展示（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt:275`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/uidebugger/UIDebuggerViewModel.kt#L275)）
7. **工具测试**：点测试卡片 → runTest 在 IO 线程调 `executeTool` → 结果按成功/失败着色 → 详情弹窗看截断后的参数与输出（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/tooltester/ToolTesterScreen.kt:80`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/tooltester/ToolTesterScreen.kt#L80)）
8. **流式演示**：点开始 → 协程逐字 `channel.send`（间隔随速度变化）→ 渲染器消费流展示 → 播完或取消时 finally 关通道（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/StreamMarkdownDemo.kt:105`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/StreamMarkdownDemo.kt#L105)）

## 来源

- 种子文件 20 个：shellexecutor（`ShellCommandManager.kt`、`ShellExecutorScreen.kt`）、sqlviewer（`SqlTableView.kt`、`SqlViewerScreen.kt`、`SqlViewerToolScreen.kt`、`SqlViewerViewModel.kt`）、logcat（`LogModels.kt`、`LogcatComponents.kt`、`LogcatExportHelper.kt`、`LogcatManager.kt`、`LogcatScreen.kt`、`LogcatViewModel.kt`）、uidebugger（`UIDebuggerState.kt`、`UIDebuggerScreen.kt`、`UIDebuggerViewModel.kt`、`UIDebuggerComponents.kt`、`components/ActivityMonitorPanel.kt`）、tooltester（`ToolTesterScreen.kt`）、`StreamMarkdownDemo.kt`

pages.text:
# ui-toolbox-filemanager（文件管理器界面）

> 种子：`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/`（13 个 Kotlin 文件，约 3,494 行）@ `dbf71916`

## 概述

这是 Operit 工具箱里的**图形化文件管理器**：浏览目录、进出文件夹、新建文件夹、复制/剪切/粘贴、重命名（含批量重命名）、删除、压缩/解压、搜索、多标签页、三种列表密度。

核心设计：**UI 层自己不直接读写文件，所有文件操作都翻译成 AI 工具调用**，经 `AIToolHandler`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:81`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L81)）执行。同一套工具既服务 AI Agent 也服务人类界面；代价是界面响应要等工具往返。

状态全部收拢在 `FileManagerViewModel`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:28`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L28)）。

界面只负责渲染：`FileManagerScreen`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt:45`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt#L45)）做总装配，底部菜单、列表、工具栏、标签栏、状态栏拆成独立可组合组件。

## AI 速览

- **核心符号**：`FileManagerScreen`（Compose 入口）、`FileManagerViewModel`（全部状态与工具调用）、`FileContextMenu`（底部动作菜单）、`FileListContent`（列表容器）、`FileListItem`（行渲染）、`FileManagerToolbar`（顶部工具栏）、`PathNavigationBar`（路径栏）、`FileManagerTabRow`（多标签）、`StatusBar`（状态栏）、`DisplayMode`（单列/双列/三列）、`FileItem`/`TabItem`（数据模型）、`getFileIcon`/`formatFileSize`（`FileUtils.kt` 工具函数）。
- **主入口**：Compose 侧 `FileManagerScreen`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt:45`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt#L45)）是界面入口。
- **状态入口**：ViewModel 的 `init` 块直接调 `loadCurrentDirectory()`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:479`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L479)）。
- **数据流向一句话**：用户手势 → ViewModel 改状态并经 `AIToolHandler` 调工具 → 结果写回状态 → Compose 重组刷新列表。

## 核心机制

### 1. 工具驱动的文件操作

界面不直接做文件 IO，各操作对应工具如下（均为构造 `AITool` 后经 `toolHandler.executeTool` 执行）：

- 浏览目录调 `list_files`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:102`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L102)）。
- 新建文件夹调 `make_directory`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:259`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L259)）。
- 搜索调 `find_files`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:300`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L300)）。
- 复制调 `copy_file`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:429`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L429)）。
- 删除调 `delete_file`，`recursive` 参数按是否为目录取值（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt:173`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt#L173)）。
- 重命名用 `move_file` 实现（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt:214`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt#L214)）。
- 压缩调 `zip_files`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt:253`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt#L253)）。
- 解压调 `unzip_files`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt:294`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt#L294)）。
- 打开调 `open_file`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt:505`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt#L505)）。
- 分享调 `share_file`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt:516`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt#L516)）。

工具调用包在 `viewModelScope` 协程 + `Dispatchers.IO` 中（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:97`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L97)），结果切回主线程写状态。

### 2. 多环境与快速访问

`currentEnvironment`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:31`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L31)）区分文件系统环境：空值为普通 Android 路径，`"linux"` 为 Linux 环境，`"repo:书签名"` 为 SAF 仓库。

`withEnvParams`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:83`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L83)）在环境非空时给工具参数追加 `environment`。

快速访问栏四个入口：

- Linux 芯片跳 `navigateToPath("/", "linux")`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt:324`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt#L324)）。
- SDCard 芯片跳外部存储根目录（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt:336`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt#L336)）。
- Workspace 芯片跳应用 `filesDir` 下的 workspace 目录（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt:349`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt#L349)）。

链路 2：新建文件夹

1. 输入：工具栏新建按钮 → `NewFolderDialog`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt:479`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/FileManagerScreen.kt#L479)）。

调 `find_files`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:300`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L300)）。
3. 输出：`searchResults` 刷新（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt:284`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/viewmodel/FileManagerViewModel.kt#L284)）。

弹出 `SearchResultsDialog`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/SearchDialogs.kt:96`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/SearchDialogs.kt#L96)）。

链路 5：删除

1. 输入：底部菜单删除 → 删除确认对话框（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt:699`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt#L699)）。
2. 处理：`deleteFile`（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt:162`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt#L162)）。

3. 输出：成功后经 `onFilesUpdated` 刷新（[`app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt:188`](https://github.com/AAswordman/Operit/blob/dbf71916fae9750cfdc9f9a774f5a0fee56633fb/app/src/main/java/com/ai/assistance/operit/ui/features/toolbox/screens/filemanager/components/FileContextMenu.kt#L188)）。

链路 6：添加 SAF 仓库书签
